notes.title: Find us at the Steam Scream Event!
notes.content:
Get ready to immerse yourselves in the newest demo of “Eldritch Climb: A Cursed Ascent” this spooky season! 

Because we love bringing cool frights and chilling adventures, you can try out our newest and updated demo! Are you new to our game? We've prepared tons of spooky monsters and weird yet useful items for your enjoyment. For those who've already played us, thrilling new challenges to face await!

What new things will you find?
[list]
[*] New items to aid on your quest to the Eldritch mysteries
[*] A mysterious book filled with Mountain secrets
[*] Fixed bugs from all your reports and feedback
[/list]

Don't miss the screams at this event, and join the spooky fun October 28th up to November 4th!

notes.title: Demo Updated
notes.content:
Thanks for your feedback on our previous release, here are the things that change with this update:

[h2]New Things and Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] 3 new Passive items added
[*] Eye particles now appear in level for you to collect
[*] Look up or down to move the camera a little and see dangers ahead
[*] Many new and improved animations
[*] We revamped our level generator to make for more interesting levels
[*] Hold down while in the air to fall a little faster
[*] Fixed collision bugs that made it hard to get on some platforms
[*] Fixed bug in dialogues that made them impossible to read
[*] Made it easier to grab a node when moving fast
[/list]

We are also hard at work on the early access release so keep us posted with any suggestions or bug reports!

notes.title: Our Demo is HERE!
notes.content:
The time has come to experience a tease of the [b]Eldritch Horrors[/b]! 

What features will you find: 
[list]
[*] Let the horrors begin: [b]Fully playable[/b] “The Mountain” level
[*] [b]4 items[/b] available to aid your adventure
[*] Meet & Greet with the first of [b]many horrid creatures[/b]: goats, flies & bombs...
[*] ... And a Gruesome [b]Level Boss[/b]!
[*] Available in English
[/list]
We would LOVE to hear all your feedback! Join the Eldritch Discord to meet more adventurers and talk to the Ancient Ones (or maybe just us): 
https://discord.gg/msZQr7mAr6

Enjoy the game!
